title: Propulsion Engineer
location: Abu Dhabi, ae | Abu Dhabi | ae | Abu Dhabi, , United Arab Emirates
description: Responsible primarily for the compliance with all GCAA CAR-M and CAP-Ops 1 requirements in connection with Etihad aircraft engines (TRENT 7000, TRENT XWB-97, V2500, LEAP-1A, GE90, GEnx and GP7200 as applicable) to maintain continued airworthiness. Accountabilities Provide technical support to other departments including Maintenance, Technical Contracts, Warranty, and Planning in relation to Propulsion issues. Issue and revise in-house publications (Technical Notices & Publication amendments (TPA)) Encourage colleagues and is actively involved in the promotion of a positive reporting culture, by reporting any unsafe acts, unsafe conditions or safety risks Ensure cost-effective engineering technical support to the operation and maintenance of the Etihad Engine/ APU fleet Support the Lead Engineer in providing program management of outsourced maintenance and engineering activities, including liaising with Engine/APU, component OEMs and maintenance providers. Assist the Lead Engineer in managing engine and component modification standards, specifications, and implementation. Assess engine and component Airworthiness Directives, Service Bulletins, and issue associated Document Assessment Reports (DARs),  Engineering Orders and fleet campaigns. Assist with the management of Engine/APU removal program & shop visits, including reviewing and approving engine workscopes & deviations. Assist with lease engines induction and return. Provide troubleshooting assistance to Maintenance Control Centre (MCC), when required. Review Engine Health Monitoring reports and notifications from OEMs, and issue required maintenance instructions to address any anomalies. Support the investigation of in-service events, delays and technical problems, and implement corrective action program to improve engine and related component reliability. Bachelor degree in Aeronautical or Mechanical Engineering or ICAO Type 11 AMEL with Type. Minimum 3 years’ experience in aircraft Engines/ APU fleet management.
